verdict.rationale: Working Copy's manual says SSH keys used for remote connections can live on the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID or Touch ID. That directly provides biometric protection of remote credentials. Missing for 10: any detail on the biometric prompt flow or setup, whether HTTPS or token credentials can also be biometric-gated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my remote connections with biometric authentication like Face ID or fingerprint

citations.quote: For extra security SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.
You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.
